data.name: SeaRay Sundecker 26’
data.headline: Private captained charter aboard a 26-foot SeaRay Sundecker for up to 11 guests with music and a floating mat included.
data.description:
Enjoy a worry-free day on the water aboard a **SeaRay Sundecker 26'**, perfect for family outings or group days with space for up to 11 guests. 

Your charter includes a captain and a Bluetooth stereo so you can set the soundtrack while you cruise Biscayne Bay, explore sandbars, or tour Millionaire's Row and Fisher Island. 

The boat also provides a large floating mat for lounging and swimming, plus complimentary ice, water and soft drinks to keep everyone refreshed.

highlight_box.title: Sunset Charters Available!
highlight_box.description: End your day the right way — on the water. Our Sunset Boat Charter offers stunning views, peaceful vibes, and unforgettable Miami skyline sunsets.

data.highlights:
* Captained private charter for a relaxed, worry-free day on the water
* Space for up to 11 guests with room to move around
* Bluetooth stereo for your favorite music and a large floating mat for swimming and lounging
* Options to visit sandbars, Millionaire's Row, Vizcaya, and scenic sunset routes
data.itinerary:
1. 2-hour trip: Tour Brickell/Biscayne Bay, marine stadium, Hobie Beach; quick swim at Monument Island or Picnic Island; sunset option via Miami River/Brickell and Fisher Island.
2. 3-hour trip: More swim time; tour Millionaire Homes and Sunset Islands; marine stadium/Hobie Beach; recommended Vizcaya sandbar or other sandbars.
3. 4-hour trip: Combines the above with more flexibility to linger at favored spots; options include Bear Cut, Nixon sandbar, No Name Harbor, Vizcaya Museum, and Key Biscayne.
4. 6-hour trip: Access to VIP/exclusive locations weather permitting, such as Stittsville and Fowey Rocks; Haulover sandbar recommended.
5. 8-hour trip: Extended time to visit multiple destinations and enjoy full-day experiences including sunset at Fisher Island.

data.booking_notes:
SeaRay Sundecker 27’

Address: 
201 NW South River Dr
Miami Fl 33128 USA

Confirmation:
SeaRay Sundecker 27’

###Here is some info that we hope will answer any questions you may have. 

1.) Please try and arrive a half hour early as we have sign coast guard documents and get you guys comfortable on the yacht. Safety first.

2.) The crew and yacht will be ready for you for the start of your contracted time. The yacht runs on a tight schedule and adjusting start times is not an option. Please try and arrive early. 

3.) The captain will address all of your guests about safety first. It’s real important that everyone is paying attention. We take the safety of our guests very seriously. 

4.) Federal Law limits the maximum amount of guests allowed on a Recreational Bareboat Charter is 13. Kids count towards the total of 13. The captain and crew DO NOT count. Please make sure we don’t have more than 13 as there are no exceptions. 

5.) Everyone must remove their shoes while onboard the yacht. 

6.) Hookahs are NOT allowed on the yacht (no exceptions). Vapes are okay. 

7.) Use of the bathroom is allowed but you must dispose of toilet paper and / or personal hygiene products in the waste basket provided. A crew member will assist you with flushing the toilet. 

8.) The yacht has a Bluetooth surround sound system for your enjoyment. A crew member will assist you in getting you connected. Once connected we will set the stereo at a safe volume. If the volume needs to be adjusted a crew member will assist you.

9.) The front master bedroom and bathroom are off limits to the guests as we have the owner’s personal belongings in there along with necessary documentation for the coast guard. The door has a sign that reads crew only no entry. Please respect the privacy of the owner. 

10.) We provide you with some ice and water for hydration. Please make sure you bring with you whatever you wish to eat and drink. Please make sure you bring cups and plates if you feel you will need them. 

11.) We will have a nice cruise from the historic Miami River to the anchorage area. We will be at the anchorage area for approximately 2 hours. You will then have the option to jump in the water, enjoy our floating Lili pad, or rent Jet Skis. If you wish to rent Jet Skis please let the captain know and he can reserve them. 

12.) If you have a balance remaining to be paid, the captain will collect it when your signing the coast guard documents on board the yacht. The balance must be paid in full before the yacht can leave the docks.

####We accept the following forms of payment. 
- Cash
- Zelle
- Cash-app 
- Venmo
- ApplePay 

The total amount that you have paid for your charter does not include any gratuity / tip for the crew. If The Captain and First Mate do a great job ensuring your safety, comfort, & enjoyment. Please show your gratitude by tipping accordingly. Thank you!

When you arrive PLEASE contact the captain and he will greet you at the main marina entrance door.

#(If captains name and phone number is not in this confirmation, the captain will call you 24 hours prior to the day of the reservation.)
data.health_and_safety_notes:
U.S. Coast Guard–approved life jackets are available for all passengers.

Children must wear life jackets at all times while onboard.

Guests must follow all captain instructions for safety.

Alcohol is permitted for guests 21+, but excessive intoxication or unsafe behavior will result in termination of the charter without refund.

No drugs or illegal substances are allowed onboard.

Swimming is allowed only when the captain determines it is safe to do so.

Guests participate at their own risk and may be required to sign a liability waiver before departure.

In the event of unsafe weather conditions, the charter may be rescheduled.
data.disclaimers: Destinations and routes are subject to weather and tide conditions; stops such as Stittsville and Fowey Rocks are weather permitting. Complimentary ice, water, and soft drinks are provided; guests may bring their own beer, wine, and liquor. Itinerary times and stops depend on departure punctuality and chosen trip duration.
data.faqs:
How old do you have to be to rent a boat?
18 Years Old
How many people can fit on the boat?

11 people
Can we bring food and drinks?
Yes! You’re welcome to bring your own food and beverages. Alcohol is allowed for guests 21+.
Is a deposit required?

Yes, a deposit is required to reserve your date. The remaining balance is due before or on the day of your charter.
Where do we go during the charter?

Popular routes include Biscayne Bay, Star Island, Monument Island, and Miami’s skyline views. Your captain can customize the route based on weather and your preferences.
Can we swim?
Yes! Most charters allow time to anchor and swim at sandbars or islands, weather permitting.
What should we bring?
Sunscreen, towels, sunglasses, food/drinks, and good vibes.
What happens if it rains?
If weather conditions are unsafe, we’ll reschedule your booking at no extra cost.
Are tips included?
Gratuity is not included. A 15–20% tip for your captain is customary if you enjoyed your experience.
